crude.title: Crude oil: where India's barrels came from
crude.volumeNote: India imported 4.84 million barrels a day of oil in calendar 2024 (Kpler data, via Business Standard).
crude.note: Russia's share rose from almost nothing before 2022. It reached about half of India's crude intake in some months of 2026, when Gulf supplies were disrupted.

dap.title: DAP fertiliser: how fast China's share fell
dap.note: More than half of India's DAP use is met by finished imports; much of the rest is made at home from imported rock phosphate and phosphoric acid. As Chinese supply dried up, India signed long-term supply deals with Saudi Arabia and Morocco in July 2025.

sources.name: Government data via PTI/Outlook Business, DAP imports from China (Mar 2025)
Rural Voice, DAP import prices and sourcing (2025)
Argus, India signs phosphate agreements with Saudi Arabia and Morocco (Jul 2025)

china.title: Products where China supplies most of what India imports
china.note: Shares are China's portion of India's total imports of each product, as reported by the Global Trade Research Initiative in August 2025. A high import share is not the same as dependence: for some products imports are a small part of what India uses. The risk is greatest where China's share is high and domestic production is thin, as with solar cells, lithium-ion cells and antibiotic ingredients.

sources.name: GTRI, India's trade deficit with China (via Business Standard, 19 Dec 2025)
